name: Imonatsu ~Okigae Shitara Dekakemasho~
original_name: いもなつ ～おきがえしたら でかけましょ～
source:
--Haishan Island.. I returned to this island, my hometown, for summer vacation.
The laid-back atmosphere unique to the countryside brought back so much nostalgia.
A small fishing port. An endless sandy beach along the coastline. The road leading to town. A small but lively town.
And a mountain shrine, where preparations are underway for the summer festival.
All of these things welcomed me, still retaining much of their former appearance.

In contrast to the island, my younger sisters, whom I met after a long time, had grown more than I expected and were truly remarkable.
For me, who has always desired the reputation of being a little sister lover, this was a truly pleasant surprise.
I only have about a week left of summer vacation to spend with my sisters...

I'd like to go to the beach. I'd like to go to the mountains too. But it's so hot, so I'll stay at home with my sisters...
There's so much I want to do. So, where should I start?
translation: ——海山岛……暑假回到了故乡的这座小岛。乡村独有的悠闲氛围带来了太多怀念。小小的渔港。沿着海岸线延伸的无尽沙滩。通往小镇的路。一个虽小却热闹的镇子。还有一座山间神社，正在为夏日祭典做准备。所有这些都还保留着当年的模样欢迎着我。与小岛形成对比的是，久别重逢的妹妹们比我想象中成长了太多，真的非常出色。对于一直渴望成为妹控的我来说，这是一个真正令人愉快的惊喜。暑假只剩下大约一周的时间可以和妹妹们一起度过了……我想去海边。也想去山上。但太热了，还是和妹妹们待在家里吧……有太多想做的事了。那么，从哪里开始呢？
